definitions.aliasEdges: References to a reachable identity after its first occurrence, including cycles and repeated roots.
definitions.loopTrips: Truthy loop test evaluations, plus the initial entry of each do/while loop; null for omitted for-loop tests.
definitions.asyncDependencyDepth: Longest normalized causal path counted at await records; not wall-clock concurrency.
definitions.peakHeapObjects: Owned heap entries including functions, measured across committed state changes.
definitions.mutationEvents: Committed heap-property-changing or binding-write events; declarations are excluded.
definitions.maxModelContextTokens: Unmeasured; native observed-token totals are not maximum context length.

definitions.peakHeapObjects: Owned heap entries including functions, measured across committed state changes.
definitions.mutationEvents: Committed heap-property-changing or binding-write events; declarations are excluded.
definitions.maxModelContextTokens: Unmeasured; native observed-token totals are not maximum context length.

campaign.privateStorage: lossless-registry-CAS; rehydrate before all admission and native consumers

storedObjects.scope: all finalized CAS objects, including failed and retried attempts

limitations: Workers are bounded trusted-source processes; OS-level isolation for untrusted programs remains required.
Worker heap limits are V8 heap limits, not whole-process cgroup memory limits.
Executed path signatures describe source-site branch and throw sequences; lexical families without a registry are not independent clusters.
